relics.name: The First Banner
relics.line1: Nobody remembers if it was Azure or Crimson.

relics.name: Sky-Stone Shard
relics.line1: A piece of the night the sky split.

relics.name: Shrine Keeper's Ladle
relics.line1: Someone once fed the egg on purpose.
relics.line2: Their last note reads: less violet.

relics.name: Waterfall Coin
relics.line1: Thrown off the edge for luck.
relics.line2: The cloud below has kept every one.

relics.name: Lamp Crystal
relics.line1: Cut from the old roads under the hill.
relics.line2: It glows brighter near anything hollow.

relics.name: Empty Seed Pouch
relics.line1: A Farmer's first harvest went straight to the egg.
relics.line2: The egg did not say thank you.

relics.name: Orchard Road Map
relics.line1: A road to an orchard of burning trees, past the edge.

relics.name: Tide Shell
relics.line1: Hold it to your ear and you hear the sea.
relics.line2: There is no sea. That is the strange part.

relics.name: Hatchling Tooth
relics.line1: Lost by a very young Kaiju.
relics.line2: Found by a very brave Miner.

relics.name: Bridge Knot
relics.line1: Builders tie this knot first and trust it most.
relics.line2: Nobody else has ever untied one.

relics.name: Burnt Fuse
relics.line1: Left by the Basin's first Demolitions Expert.
relics.line2: Found a long way from where it was lit.

relics.name: Crown of the Hill
relics.line1: Whoever wore it held the hill from dawn to dusk.
relics.line2: Then they came down for supper.
